notes.title: v1.3 patch note
notes.content:
Here are the modifications provided by v1.3:

[list]
[*] Randomizer now available on Second Quest
[*] Added a camera smoothing option
[*] Loading screen now shows progress (prevents the "game is not responding" issue on some OS)
[*] Improved mouse input
[*] Improved frame interpolation (removes camera stuttering and lag on on screen weapons)
[*] Improved performances
[*] Fixed the wrong display of command on first launch in english (ZQSD instead of WASD)
[*] Fixed the hive and wasp crash
[/list]

To launch the Second Quest in randomizer mode, hold [b]R[/b] (or [b]LB[/b] on a controller) [b]while clicking "Yes" on the Second Quest confirmation dialog.[/b]
Due to changes to the mouse code, you might need to reajust your mouse speed.
Some mouses cause stuttering issues; if you're in that case you can use the new camera smoothing option to prevent it.

Have fun everyone!

notes.title: The Second Quest content update is now available!
notes.content:
The [b]Second Quest[/b] update for The End of Dyeus is [b]now available![/b]
This is a free content update which also adds a bunch of new features.

[previewyoutube=OEfuloaVTWk;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Featuring:[/i]

[*] [b]Second Quest[/b]: a harder quest offering to [b]rediscover the game's world with new challenges[/b]
[*] [b]Revamped and improved randomizer[/b]
[*] [b]Full controller support[/b]
[*] [b]Dynamic lighting[/b]
[*] Hugely improved performances
[*] New draw distance setting for low end computers
[*] Some slight balance changes (mostly to Aves)
[*] Various bug fixes

To play the Second Quest, either [b]select a cleared game[/b] or [b]start a new game[/b] while holding [b]S and Q[/b] (or [b]SELECT[/b] on a controller).
To play in randomizer mode, [b]start a new game[/b] while holding [b]R[/b] (or [b]LB[/b] on a controller).

Please consider joining the [b][url=https://discord.gg/g667h3MEmQ]Curious Planet Discord[/url][/b] to share tips with other players, and stay tuned about future Curious Planet games.

Good luck!

notes.title: v1.1 patch note
notes.content:
Here are the modifications provided by v1.1:

[list]
[*] You can't block in the inventory anymore
[*] The attack value of oil jars has been corrected
[*] A tutorial has been added for an end game item
[*] The stock of oil jars is now limited in shops
[*] The "melee only" and "distance only" feats now depends on used weapons, not obtained weapons
[*] Slight changes in the combat area of Salamandra
[*] Boss explosions can't pu vegetation on fire anymore
[*] Coconuts now heal 2HP
[*] Piercing arrows can now pierce through helmets (but don't do critical hits)
[*] Enemies wearing helmets now have an animation when hit in the helmet with an arrow
[*] A secret boss can't be beaten with distance weapons anymore
[*] Collisions of a static mesh adjusted
[*] Fixed an major issue with the third boss, who could stop engaging the player
[*] Minor change to the third boss attack pattern
[*] Fixed an issue with a building disappearing
[/list]

Have fun everyone!

notes.title: The End of Dyeus is now available!
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce that [b]The End of Dyeus is now available![/b]

Find your own equipment, explore a wild and cryptic open world, fight the Shadows, the Guardians and wild animals and uncover the secret of Dyeus and this ruined world.

[previewyoutube=P4yaMhCT0mg;full][/previewyoutube]

Consider joining the [b][url=https://discord.gg/g667h3MEmQ]Curious Planet Discord[/url][/b] to share tips and advice with other players, and to be informed about future Curious Planet games!

Have fun everyone!

notes.title: The End of Dyeus will be available on October 15th!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=SJK32cQeADM;full][/previewyoutube]

I'm glad to announce that The End of Dyeus will be available on October 15th!
It has been quite a ride, and I'm really proud of the result.

Expect a lot of new features if you've played the BETA, like new combat mechanics, new weapons and enemies, more interactions with the world, a richer lore... and more.

Consider adding the game to your wishlist if not done, and see you in October!

notes.title: The End of Dyeus BETA is available!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that you can now try the BETA of The End of Dyeus!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304400/The_End_of_Dyeus/][b]>> Sign up for the BETA[/b][/url]

A few notes:
[list]
[*] Some feats are not calibrated yet, particularly "Minimalist" and "Only melee", which haven't been tested. Feel free to try them!
[*] The final boss uses the same music as other bosses for now, but it will get its own in the final game.
[*] Some sound effects are missing, but you shouldn't notice it too much.
[/list]
If you've got a YouTube channel / Twitch account, feel free to record the game, it would give it more visibility, and can help me spot issues with it.

You can give me your feedbacks on the Curious Planet Discord, or by clicking "Report an issue" in the pause menu.
Also remember to add the game to your wishlist!

[url=https://discord.gg/g667h3MEmQ][b]>> Curious Planet Discord[/b][/url]

Have fun!

We're still looking at the fauna of The End of Dyeus today, with the Odona.
Extremely fast, this bug won't leave you alone until you get rid of it... or the other way around.

notes.title: Enemy Showcase: the Toards
notes.content:
One last peek at the wild life of The End of Dyeus: the Toards.
You'll need a good timing to take these toads and there impressive jaws down!

[previewyoutube=ZZGEzymZEXg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Enemy Showcase: the Skeel
notes.content:
New day, new enemy: the Skeel.

Today we're peeking at the wild life of The End of Dyeus. These sneaky creatures will charge at you whenever you'll wet your feet...
There are other approaches, but they can't do much against a good bow and arrows hehe.

[previewyoutube=slbHN0H-63A;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Enemy Showcase: the Nahash Grenadier
notes.content:
it's time to introduce the Nahash Grenadier! (with a guest?)

Be ready for noisy and chaotic fights with this guy. He's not really a delicate opponent... so why not try and lure him into blowing his friends up?

[previewyoutube=dYRfcKbT-Qs;full][/previewyoutube]

New enemy of the day: the Red Crystal!

A rare and dangerous opponent, hidden in the remotest corners of the world.
Destroy it to get an interesting reward...

[previewyoutube=5xMFw6-1zdo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Enemy Showcase: the Shadow Chief
notes.content:
New program: every wednesday, I'll introduce an enemy from The End of Dyeus in a small video (every two days to catch up with the videos already on YouTube!).

We start with the Shadow Chief!
A fast and deadly foe, equiped with a sword and a shield.
You'd better think of a good strategy before facing him...
